intro.text: A zealous arteth who says he is an Arelene convert to Shu-Dereth; the gyorn Hrathen makes him his odiv, both to reward and to control him.
Hrathen's fanatical odiv, a charismatic preacher whose hatred of the Elantrians stirs crowds against them.
A gragdet, the head of a Derethi monastery, who spent years posing as an Arelene convert to Shu-Dereth and leads the Derethi invasion of Arelon.

items.text: A Dakhor monk, Dilaf was altered to look like a young Arelene and sent to spy in Arelon. When a failed Elantrian healing left the woman he loved in agony, he came to hate Elantris, and settled in Naen posing as an Arelene convert to Shu-Dereth.

Dilaf told Hrathen he was an Arelene who had taken up the Derethi faith and gathered a following in Naen, and that the arteth Fjon had raised him to arteth without the authority to. Impressed but wary of his ardour, Hrathen made him arteth and odiv.
Against Hrathen's orders, Dilaf followed his sermon with a fiery one of his own. It won the crowd, and Hrathen both disciplined and praised him.
Dilaf tortured the Elantrian Diren and drove a crowd into a murderous frenzy against him, until Hrathen turned the mob aside.
Hrathen grew uneasy as Dilaf gained influence over the chapel, and began to suspect that his odiv was older and more seasoned than he appeared.
Hrathen reasserted his authority over the chapel, but Dilaf still insisted on his hatred of Elantris.
Dilaf used the Dor to strip away Raoden's disguise before the court, but stalked out angry when the reaction was not what he had expected.

After Raoden was crowned, Dilaf revealed himself as a gragdet, the head of a monastery, outranking Hrathen, and began an invasion with warrior-monks smuggled into Arelon. Hrathen's appointments had never had any force.
Dilaf's aim was the slaughter of the whole Arelene nation. He besieged Kiin's house and used the captured Raoden to bargain for Sarene.

Dilaf took Hrathen, Sarene and his monks to Teod by teleportation fuelled by a monk's life. As he began cutting Sarene's throat in front of her father, King Eventeo, Hrathen struck him, broke his nose and fled with her.
Dilaf cornered Raoden and Sarene in Teod, but Hrathen returned and killed him with unnatural strength before dying of his own wounds.

appearance.text: He looks like a short, blond Arelene of no more than twenty-five, though he is nearly seventy and was once a tall Derethi man. He usually wears the red robes of a Derethi priest.
Like other Dakhor monks, his body is twisted by their magic: his arms are like knotted branches, with ridges and symbols of bone beneath taut skin.

personality.text: His eyes burn with passion, and he rarely hides his emotions, from religious fervour to deep hatred. He cannot get along with people.
